readback: Gold tier members get a one-time 100 bonus points (DELTA MILES) on each Spend transaction made on a Saturday or Sunday, when the amount is $50 or more and the store is Chennai HQ (HQ) or Elite Group Online (WEB). The bonus is given once per transaction, even if both conditions match.
assumptions: "Spends" means the SPEND activity type (Spend). If you meant PURCHASE (Shopping), it can be switched or added.
Gold tier is checked using the member's Tier Class. The catalog has two Gold codes (GOLD and Gold), so both are included.
"Chennai HQ store" is location code HQ. The separate location code 'Chennai' is not included.
"Online store" is location WEB (Elite Group Online).
Weekend means Saturday (6) and Sunday (7), based on the transaction date.
"At least $50" means a BIT Amount of 50 or more. Currency is not checked.
No start or end date and no per-member usage limit were given, so the bonus applies to every qualifying transaction with no time limit.
